title: Database error text disclosed in a response
description: The response body contains a database driver error (a SQL driver error). Driver messages reveal table names, query shape, and engine type, which help an attacker refine injection attempts.
remediation: Catch database errors server-side and return a generic message with a correlation ID (a generic error page with a correlation ID).
limitation: Marker text on one body: a quoted driver message in documentation or a support article can match.

check.valuePattern: You have an error in your SQL syntax|SQLSTATE\[|\bORA-\d{5}|Unclosed quotation mark after the character string|PG::SyntaxError|ERROR:\s+syntax error at or near

observation.body: Error: You have an error in your SQL syntax; check the manual near '' at line 1
SQLSTATE[42000]: Syntax error or access violation
ORA-00933: SQL command not properly ended
